name: models
description: Architecture models: a proven system's vertical and horizontal shape as data, shipped with the CLI or kept by a project (docs/design/models.md).

MODEL-FORMAT.fix: give the model folder a model.json with name, title, description, layers and slice; layers and domains with unique ids and kinds from the vocabulary; rules of known types; contracts between known ids; decisions as Decision docs (docs: Models)

commands.name: models
commands.does: list the architecture models this project can apply; doc writes a project model's Model doc for the owner to approve

messages.modelName: model {{model}} is named {{name}} inside: the folder name is its name
messages.modelItemId: model {{model}}: an item of {{key}} has no id
messages.modelKind: model {{model}}: {{id}} has kind {{kind}}, not one of {{kinds}}
messages.modelRule: model {{model}}: rule type {{type}} is not one of {{types}}
messages.modelContract: model {{model}}: a contract's {{end}} is {{id}}, which is no layer, domain or the slice
messages.modelDecision: model {{model}}: decisions/{{file}} is not a Decision doc
messages.modelNone: no models: the plugin ships none yet, and the project keeps its own in {{dir}}/<name>/
messages.modelsUsage: usage: aidlc models, or aidlc models doc <name> for a project model
messages.modelUnknown: no project model {{name}} in {{dir}}: aidlc models lists them
messages.modelDocWrote: wrote {{path}} from {{file}}: ask the owner to approve it (aidlc approve {{path}})

steps.research: a Research digest under research/ for each name in research:
steps.model: a current Model doc for model: (aidlc models doc <name>), its model in the format

MODEL-SOURCE.fix: give each layer, domain and rule of the model sources: ids of the sources of the research: digests the intent names (docs: Models)
